question: Which of the following is NOT a herbivore?
solution:
The correct answer is **Hawk**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **herbivore **is an organism that f**eeds mostly on plants**.
 
• Herbivores range in **size from tiny insects** such as aphids to **large, lumbering elephants**.
 
• As a result of their** plant diet,** herbivorous animals typically have **mouthparts adapted to rasping or grinding.**
 
• From the following list of animals** sheep, grasshoppers and rabbits **are the animals that** have plants as their diet**.
 
• **Hawks are carnivorous**, which means they **eat animals**, not plants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are many types of herbivores like we have** Frugivores** which feed on** fruits, Folivores** which eat **mostly leaves,** and **xylophages** which eat **wood**.
 
• They can be very **large or very small.**
 
• They are known as **primary consumers** in the** food chain.**
